metadata.title: Public Health Analytics-OS persistent identity and lifecycle policy

identityFields.canonicalObjectId: Stable Analytics-OS identifier for one governed object. Existing released record IDs are retained as the initial canonical IDs.
identityFields.canonicalUri: Persistent URI formed by appending the percent-encoded canonicalObjectId to the canonical namespace.
identityFields.sourceManifestationId: Identifier carried by the source-layer record or retained from the source manifestation.
identityFields.representationId: Unique identifier for a particular registry, HMIS, graph, report-schema or interoperability representation of a canonical object.
identityFields.occurrenceId: Unique identifier for a field appearance in a particular report schema; it does not replace the canonical data-element identity.
identityFields.businessVersion: Semantic version of the governed Analytics-OS object meaning, independent of source, schema and software releases.
identityFields.sourceVersion: Version or period asserted by the source representation.
identityFields.schemaVersion: Version of the structural contract used to serialize a representation.

lifecycleRules: An identifier is never reassigned to a different meaning.
Editorial corrections that do not change meaning retain canonicalObjectId and increment the patch business version.
Backward-compatible metadata enrichment retains canonicalObjectId and increments the minor business version when material to consumers.
A material change to population, event, numerator, denominator, scale, time window or intended interpretation creates a new canonicalObjectId and a major-version or replacement relationship.
retirementDate is present only for retired or superseded identities.
replaces and replacedBy are reciprocal and do not assert semantic equivalence by themselves.
Source withdrawal or obsolescence does not delete an identity; it changes lifecycle or source-version status with provenance.
The current baseline businessVersion 1.0.0 records first governed identity assignment, not the first version ever issued by the source custodian.
deduplicationRules: An identical released ID with the same normalized name and compatible canonical type is one canonical object with multiple representations.
Matching labels without a shared stable identity are not automatically merged.
The 54 HMIS derived-indicator records that share released registry IDs are represented once canonically and retain both source representations.
Report occurrences link to a canonical element when a reviewed crosswalk exists; candidate occurrences remain non-canonical until governed promotion.
publicationBoundary: The identity index supports discovery and deduplication. It does not assert semantic equivalence, aggregation safety, computability, source-custodian approval or the availability of observed values.
